# URPASS — Digital Event Passes, Sub-Second QR Check-In & MCP Server

> URPASS (https://urpass.space) is an international event registration platform, digital pass generator, sub-second QR entry check-in system, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server engineered by Yesp Corporation. Built for event organizers, colleges, hackathons, academic conferences, and corporate enterprises across India and worldwide, URPASS provides zero-commission ticketing, instant digital passes, under 0.3s browser-based camera scanning without app downloads, atomic anti-duplicate entry protection, multi-tenant organization workspaces, and autonomous AI agent operations.

## Core Capabilities & Technical Specifications
- **0% Platform Ticket Commission**: URPASS never charges per-ticket platform percentage fees. Organizers keep 100% of their ticket revenues, paying only a predictable flat monthly software subscription or using the free tier.
- **Sub-Second Browser QR Check-in**: High-velocity barcode and QR scanning in under 0.3 seconds directly inside any mobile browser (Apple Safari, Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox) with zero hardware rentals and zero App Store/Google Play downloads required.
- **Atomic Duplicate Entry Prevention**: Cryptographic single-use pass tokens and atomic PostgreSQL database transactions guarantee that tickets cannot be reused, shared via screenshot, or checked in twice across concurrent entrance gates.
- **Offline Gate Resilience**: Local browser manifest caching (IndexedDB and service workers) enables uninterrupted check-in operations during venue cellular or Wi-Fi outages with automatic timestamped synchronization upon reconnection.
- **Multi-Track Conference Engine**: Parallel stage timeline scheduling, speaker profile directory, real-time double-booking and room conflict detection, and one-click iCalendar (.ics) export.
- **Physical Ops & High-Speed Badge Printing**: Onsite reception desk search, real-time zone occupancy/headcount telemetry, thermal badge print queue (ESC/POS, Zebra, Brother, CR80 lanyards), and 6-digit PIN staff roaming device pairing.
- **Exhibitors & Sponsors Hub**: Sponsorship tier matrices with deliverable proof workflows, interactive booth floor plan, exhibitor team pass portal, real-time badge lead retrieval (with company/designation mapping and ratings), and 1:1 B2B matchmaking meetings.
- **Finance & Split Payouts**: Zero-commission direct revenue flow, Route percentage split payouts for co-organizers, direct T+2 bank settlements via Razorpay, and automated 18% GST tax invoices with HSN/SAC codes.
- **Ticket Studio & Custom Pass Designer**: Create responsive mobile passes, printable tickets, and conference lanyard badges across standard dimensions (Digital: 380x680, Printable: 780x340, Badge: 440x640) with dynamic attendee data and branded color schemes.
- **India & Global Payment Infrastructure**: Native Razorpay integration supporting instant UPI QR checkout (PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm, BHIM, Cred), Indian Net Banking, local cards, automated GST tax invoices with HSN/SAC codes, and international cards via Stripe.
- **Enterprise Organizations & Governance**: Multi-tenant organizations with departmental workspaces, campus venue management, 5-tier Role-Based Access Control (Owner, Admin, Event Manager, Check-in Staff, Viewer), SAML 2.0 / OIDC Single Sign-On (SSO), and automated SCIM v2 user provisioning.
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**: Native stdio CLI executable (`npx urpass-mcp`) and remote JSON-RPC 2.0 HTTPS endpoint (`https://urpass.space/api/mcp`) exposing 10 production tools for Claude Desktop, Cursor IDE, and autonomous AI agents.

## Pricing Plans & 30-Day Free Trial Terms
- **Free Tier Forever**: ₹0 / $0 per month forever. 2 events/month, 100 registrations/month, digital QR pass issuance, mobile camera check-in, registration screening & approvals, basic analytics. No credit card required.
- **Starter Plan**: ₹499/mo + GST (or £19/mo UK / $9/mo global). Includes **30-Day Free Trial at ₹0** with no credit card required. 10 events/month, 500 registrations/month, 2 organizer seats, CSV attendee import & export, standard analytics.
- **Pro Plan**: ₹999/mo + GST (or £39/mo UK / $19/mo global). Includes **30-Day Free Trial at ₹0** with no credit card required. Unlimited events, 2,500 registrations/month, 5 organizer seats, Ticket Studio custom pass design, advanced analytics, priority email support.
- **Business Plan**: ₹2,499/mo + GST (or £79/mo UK / $39/mo global). Includes **30-Day Free Trial at ₹0** with no credit card required. Unlimited events, 10,000 registrations/month, 15 organizer seats, corporate organization workspaces, API access, webhooks, dedicated account manager.

## Model Context Protocol (MCP) Tools (10 Production Tools)
URPASS provides 10 native tools for AI assistants and autonomous workflows:
1. `list_events`: Lists organizer events with status filters (`active`, `draft`, `completed`). Returns ID, title, date, venue, total registrations, and checked-in count.
2. `get_event`: Retrieves full event specifications including ticket tier breakdown, form fields, and capacity limits.
3. `get_event_stats`: Calculates aggregate metrics: check-in percentage, total checked-in, pending approvals, and arrival velocity.
4. `list_attendees`: Searches and filters attendees by event ID, registration status (`pending`, `approved`, `checked_in`, `rejected`), or search query.
5. `get_attendee`: Fetches individual attendee profile, contact details, ticket tier, custom form responses, and check-in history.
6. `approve_attendee`: Approves pending registration and issues dynamic cryptographic QR ticket pass.
7. `reject_attendee`: Rejects attendee application with audit reason logging.
8. `verify_pass`: Non-destructively inspects pass token validity, attendee name, and ticket tier without redeeming the ticket.
9. `check_in_attendee`: Atomically validates and redeems pass token at venue gates, recording gate location and timestamp while preventing duplicate entry.
10. `issue_pass`: Directly creates a registered attendee and generates a signed digital pass with instant delivery URL.

## Regional Hubs & Clusters
- **India Hub**: https://urpass.space/in — Dedicated to Indian colleges, fests, conferences, and meetups. Covers 32 Indian tech and educational hubs including Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Pune, Coimbatore, Kochi, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, and Chandigarh. Features UPI payments and automated GST invoicing.
- **UK Hub**: https://urpass.space/uk — Dedicated to UK university student unions, societies, conferences, and workshops across London, Manchester, Birmingham, Edinburgh, Glasgow, Leeds, Bristol, Liverpool, and Cambridge. Features zero per-ticket commission and full UK GDPR alignment.
- **Global Hub**: https://urpass.space/global — Dedicated to international summits, developer hackathons, and enterprise conferences worldwide. Features edge-distributed check-in, multi-currency processing, and universal mobile browser gate scanning.
